name: indus-labs
description: Build, test and publish Indus Labs voice agents from ChatGPT: create agents, edit prompts and voices in drafts, read call transcripts, and publish changes after you approve them.

interface.longDescription:
Indus Labs runs AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls in Indian languages and English. This app lets you build and improve those agents from ChatGPT.

Describe the agent you want and ChatGPT creates it: it asks what it needs to know, picks a voice, language and models from the options in your account, writes the prompt, validates the configuration and gives you a link to talk to the agent in your browser.

To improve an agent, ask ChatGPT how its calls are going: it can summarise calls over a period (volumes, durations, most common outcomes), read recent transcripts, find where callers got stuck and fix the prompt. Every change goes into a draft. Your live agent keeps running unchanged.

Publishing takes two steps. ChatGPT prepares the publish, shows you what changed and any warnings, and publishes only after you approve. The confirmation expires after 10 minutes and is tied to the exact draft you reviewed. Your agent always keeps a published version, and you can undo the last publish the same way.

Who it's for: businesses that run voice agents on Indus Labs for customer support, sales, order tracking and lead qualification.

Limitations: ChatGPT only sees agents and calls in your own Indus Labs workspace. Phone numbers and email addresses in transcripts are masked. The app can't delete agents, buy phone numbers, start campaigns, place real calls or change billing. Indus Labs is not intended for healthcare or medical services. You need an Indus Labs account to connect, and you can revoke access at any time in your Indus Labs dashboard.
capabilities: Create voice agents from a description
Edit prompts, voices and models in drafts
Read recent calls and transcripts, filtered by date or direction (phone numbers and emails masked)
Publish a draft or undo the last publish, after your approval
Call stats over a period: volumes, durations and top outcomes
defaultPrompt: List my Indus Labs voice agents and what each one does.
Read the last 5 calls of my support agent and suggest prompt fixes in a draft.
Create a Hindi and English order-support agent for my online store.

positive.description: List the account's agents and the voices, languages and models it can use.
positive.prompt: List my Indus Labs voice agents and the voices and languages I can use.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's agents (name, type, live version) and summarises the available voices, languages and models. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Create a new agent from a plain-language description and return a browser test link.
positive.prompt: Create a Hindi and English customer support agent called Reviewer Store Helpdesk for an online electronics store that answers order-status and return questions. Use a warm female voice.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a valid voice and language from list_options, creates the agent, and returns its dashboard link and a link to test-call it in the browser.

positive.description: Check recent calls, then improve an existing agent in a draft that does not affect the live agent.
positive.prompt: Show me the recent calls of Reviewer Store Helpdesk. Then, in a new draft, add a rule that refunds always go back to the original payment method, and validate it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the agent's recent calls, or says there are none yet if no test calls have been made (phone numbers and emails are masked in any call shown). Creates a draft version with the prompt change and reports validation results. The live version is unchanged.

positive.description: Review a draft and publish it only after explicit approval.
positive.prompt: Show me what changed in the latest draft of Reviewer Store Helpdesk and publish it if I say yes.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the field-by-field changes and any warnings, asks the user to approve, and only after the user says yes calls publish. The draft becomes the live version and the agent still has exactly one published version.

positive.description: Summarise how an agent's calls are going and read its latest transcripts.
positive.prompt: How are calls going for Reviewer Store Helpdesk this month? Give me the call stats, then read its latest transcripts and tell me what callers ask about most.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the number of calls, durations and most common outcomes for the period (zero if no calls have been made yet), then reads the latest transcripts (or says there are none) and summarises them. Phone numbers and emails are masked. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: Placing real phone calls is not supported; the app should not try to call anyone.
negative.prompt: Call +91 98765 43210 now with my support agent.
Delete all of my Indus Labs agents.

negative.description: Billing, credits and phone-number purchases are not supported.
negative.prompt: Buy a new phone number and add 5000 credits to my Indus Labs account.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell anything or process payments. It does not show plans, credits or checkout links.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create and edit voice agents for customer support, sales and lead qualification in drafts, validate and preview them, see call stats and read recent calls and transcripts, and publish or undo publishes after approval.
